def execute_boogie_woogie_jujutsu(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Todo swaps the positions of eligible targets when he activates the technique with a clap-like trigger.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    a,b = validate_swap_targets(actor,target)
    pos_a,pos_b = snapshot_positions(a,b)
    if can_occupy(b,pos_a) and can_occupy(a,pos_b):
        commit_atomic_swap(a,b,pos_a,pos_b)
    else: return DESTINATION_BLOCKED
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
